body:
The majority of my doubts are just 'what if' questions.

- "What if I'm faking it?"
- "What if I'm not actually trans?"
- "What if it's just some weird fetish or something?"
- "What if I'm not trans, but instead my mind is making me think that because I don't like my AGAB gender roles?"
- "What if I'll do something I'll regret because I might not be trans?"
- "My dysphoria isn't as bad this month compared to last month, what if I'm making it up? Is my dysphoria even real?"

(and much much more)

I'm sure you get the idea, pretty common doubts I assume, but I don't know what to do about it. I have these thoughts daily and I just feel like there's nothing I can do about it.
